correctness.rationale: The standard-library verifier checks all 2,002 induced nine-vertex supports and all 1,001 induced ten-vertex supports by exact GF(2) boundary ranks, finds the 21 positive supports, and separately verifies that their complements are precisely two points plus two avoiding lines. The ambient Hasse matching has 225 acyclic pairs with 1 critical 0-cell and six 3-cells; all 21 induced complexes have 69 acyclic pairs with 1 critical 0-cell and 1 critical 3-cell. Every local GF(2) H3 generator is checked against the FULL global fourth-boundary image, and the 21 classes enlarge rank 44 to 50, proving mod2 survival and generation. Vanishing mod2 bounds rational homology; integral sphere homotopy and free ambient H3 convert surviving mod2 classes to nonzero rational maps. Does not claim saturated integral generation.

value.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is a canonical highly symmetric object with known six-dimensional homology but previously unquantified local support constraints. The new sharp minimum and complete 21-sphere orbit classification, supplemented by full ambient generation and Hochster’s β_{6,10}=21, answer natural exact local-to-global topology and algebraic-invariant questions. This is not a routine rank repetition; it establishes all inclusion-essential minimum supports and their full homological span.
